statements.text: This strategic investment and key innovative partnership between Fermi America and the Texas Tech University System is expected to establish the world's largest energy-driven data center, placing America firmly at the forefront of the global AI race against the Chinese Communist Party. This project signals the start of a new chapter of high-impact investment in the Texas Panhandle.

statements.text: As defense competition intensifies between America and our foreign adversaries, it is absolutely critical that we maintain our technological edge and lead the world in defense innovation. The GUARD Act ensures America never falls behind in the AI arms race while giving our warfighters the decisive advantage they need to protect our homeland and defend our interests around the globe.
statements.venue: Press release on introducing GUARD Act

statements.text:
China and our adversaries are pouring massive resources into AI, and America cannot afford to fall behind!

The GUARD Act delivers on President Trump’s mission to ensure America remains the global leader in defense innovation, giving our warfighters the AI-driven edge to dominate our enemies and protect America’s future. https://t.co/w8ry9nbqxV

President Trump is leading the fight to secure America’s FUTURE with AI and defense innovation. 

We CANNOT let China or any enemy get ahead. I’ll stand with him every step of the way to keep America STRONG!

https://t.co/5QDJt5lzYS

The House JUST passed the FY26 NDAA. I was proud to secure major wins for TX-13 and the great state of Texas in this bill, including accelerated FLRAA production in Amarillo, a new national security and defense AI institute, and critical modernization at the Pantex Plant! 

These provisions give our warfighters the unmatched advantage they NEED and keep America STRONG, SECURE, and firmly on the path to GREATNESS.

NO company, Anthropic included, should be able to control how the military operates!

The Commander in Chief and Secretary of War are the ONLY people who should be making these decisions. A CEO with WOKE ideology should have absolutely NO SAY!! https://t.co/h8RXeaBHC7
